sources.title: List of countries having reached unilateral and bilateral visa exemption agreement with Laos
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The current agreement table is published directly on the Lao Ministry of Foreign Affairs mofa.gov.la domain and is also linked from the Ministry's current agreement-page record.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The table distinguishes passport categories and ordinary-passport exemption rows. It does not positively establish a held nationality's ordinary-passport route.

sources.title: Lao eVisa live country-price selector API
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Lao eVisa application client uses the mxf.laoevisa.gov.la Ministry service; the official terms identify laoevisa.gov.la as owned, operated and made by the Lao Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The live API returns 162 country records with is_except, stay_day and watchlist fields; it positively establishes only named selectable nationalities.

sources.title: Lao Official Online Visa FAQ and terms
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The related current terms page at https://laoevisa.gov.la/term/ expressly identifies the service as Ministry of Foreign Affairs-owned and operated.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Only ordinary passports may use eVisa; approved applicants receive an approval letter. The FAQ has no nationality-specific VOA schedule for held passports.

sources.title: Department of Immigration visa-category service
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Department of Immigration website's current Visa page requests this api.immigration.gov.la endpoint for its visa-category content.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tourist Visa T-B3 is issued to tourists; the exemption category embeds the waiver table. Neither gives a held nationality's issuance route.

sources.title: Decree on penalties and other measures for entry, exit and foreigner management
sources.officialityEvidence: The decree bears the Lao PDR government emblem and is served from the official Department of Immigration API domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa on arrival depends on a Ministry of Foreign Affairs nationality notice and excludes watch-listed nationals; no current official schedule is exposed.

sources.title: Laos international border checkpoints
sources.officialityEvidence: The current immigration.gov.la service identifies the Department of Immigration and labels each checkpoint's available services.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Several checkpoints are labelled Visa on Arrival and eVisa, but the labels are port-service information, not a nationality-eligibility list.

unresolved.reason: The current foreigner-entry sources do not directly establish a Lao citizen's ordinary-passport entry/right-of-return classification. Citizenship is not normalized by inference.
